data.description: If a barbed devil hits with the indicated attack, it deals normal damage and can attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. A barbed devil can use its grab attack against a foe of up to Medium size. A barbed devil has the option to conduct the grapple normally, or simply use the part of its body it used in the grab to hold the opponent. If it chooses to do the latter, it takes a -20 penalty on its CMB check to make and maintain the grapple, but does not gain the grappled condition itself. A successful hold does not deal any extra damage. Each successful grapple check you make during successive rounds automatically deals the damage indicated for the attack that established the hold. A barbed devil receives a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to start and maintain a grapple.
data.name: Grab
